title: GET /api/v1/cards?ids= 200
description: Up to 100 distinct ids looked up at once. data holds the found cards and missing the ids that were not found, each in request order, duplicates collapsed to their first occurrence. A valid request is always a 200, even when every id is missing; an empty list, more than 100 distinct ids or a malformed id is a 400 (error.json, field ids).
